items.title: MIL-STD-461
items.description: Department of Defense interface and verification requirements addressing electromagnetic interference characteristics of electronic, electrical, and electromechanical equipment and subsystems.

items.title: NFPA 70 — National Electrical Code
items.description: Electrical installation standard addressing practical safeguarding of persons and property from hazards arising from the use of electricity.

items.title: NFPA 79 — Electrical Standard for Industrial Machinery
items.description: Electrical safety standard addressing electrical and electronic equipment, apparatus, and systems associated with industrial machinery.

items.title: ABET Engineering Technology Accreditation Criteria
items.description: Accreditation criteria used to evaluate postsecondary engineering technology programs, including curriculum, student outcomes, continuous improvement, faculty, facilities, and institutional support.

items.title: Systems Modeling Language (SysML)
items.description: General-purpose systems modeling language used to represent system requirements, structure, behavior, interfaces, parameters, and relationships in model-based systems engineering.
